description: Mint a Delegated Spend Key: a scoped child MPP32 agent key for a sub-agent, with its own hard spending bounds (at least one of budgetLimitUsd, velocityLimitUsd, maxPricePerCallUsd is required), an optional service allowlist, and optional expiry. Its spend rolls up into your session budget and it can never exceed your own limits. The child apiKey is returned ONCE — hand it to the sub-agent only, do not log it. Requires MPP32_AGENT_KEY.

agentName.description: Name of the sub-agent that will use the key.

allowedServices.description: Service slugs the child may pay for. Omit for no allowlist.

budgetLimitUsd.description: Total USD the child may spend.

maxPricePerCallUsd.description: Max USD for any single call.

name: create_delegated_spend_key
